rationale: The position is currently underwater (-1.71%) and trading below the 9-EMA ($74.63), indicating that the initial V-shaped recovery has stalled and sellers are regaining control. However, the price remains above the session low ($73.42) and the invalidation level ($73.40), and the fundamental catalyst (earnings beat) remains intact, suggesting the gap-down may still be an overreaction rather than a trend reversal. Closing now would lock in a loss near the bottom of the range without a confirmed breakdown, while holding allows the trade to either recover to the EMA or hit the stop if the low is breached.
